title: The member right rail's panels sit on the canvas at the full rail width, and the Feed's four shortcuts stand out as glass tiles with an iridescent icon chip

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (screenshot of /feed): remove backgrounds from right rail content and make the content wider in the space. Then: these feature buttons (the Feed's Your Spaces, Events, Messages, Practices row) need to stand out.

detail: Each right-rail panel (Get started, Today's goals, Your week, the local board, Your Circles this season, People to know) and each platform panel in .fqm-legacy drew a glass card with 22px padding, which narrowed the content inside an already narrow rail. They now drop the glass, blur, shadow and radius and keep only a bottom padding, with a hairline between panels; Get started loses its aura. The rule sits in the utilities layer so it outranks the legacy panels' own utility-layer card. The phone's inline panel copy on the Feed is unchanged. The Feed's shortcuts row (.fa-quick: Your Spaces or Your Circles, Events, Messages, Practices) drew faint white-60 chips with a muted icon; each is now a glass tile with the panel shadow, its icon on a 36px iridescent chip in the on-accent text colour, the label in the display face, and a 2px lift on hover (none under reduced motion).

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');if(!s.includes(':is(.fqm-r-stack > :is(.fqm-rp, .fqm-gs), .fqm-legacy section:not(section section)){padding:0 0 20px;border-radius:0;background:none')||!s.includes('.fa-quick a svg { box-sizing: content-box; width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 9px; border-radius: var(--fq-radius-s); background: var(--fq-iridescent-sweep-deep)')){console.error('SCAN-873: the right rail panels still draw a card, or the Feed shortcuts still read as faint chips');process.exit(1)}"
